blocks.text: Population survivorship kisi group ke un afraad ki percentage hai jo kisi khaas umr tak zinda hain. Ise aksar survivorship graphs mein survivorship curves ki shakal mein dikhaya jata hai. In graphs mein Y-axis par zinda bache hue afraad ki tadaad aur X-axis par umr hoti hai. Aise graphs mein teen qisam ke survivorship curves bante hain.

blocks.alt: Bache hue afraad ki tadaad (log scale 0, 1, 10, 100) aur umr (1, 3, 5) ka graph. Type I (convex), surkh, ooncha rehta aur aakhir mein tezi se girta. Type II (diagonal), neela, upar baen se neeche daen seedhi lakeer. Type III (concave), narangi, foran tezi se gir kar neeche seedha ho jata.
blocks.caption: Figure 25.7: Survivorship curves (kitab ki Figure 25.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Y-axis log scale hai: har nishaan pichhle se das guna (1, 10, 100). Isi liye Type II ki seedhi lakeer ka matlab hai ke har umr mein marne ka imkaan aik jaisa hai.

items: Type I (convex, bahar ko ubhra hua) populations: In mein afraad budhape tak zinda rehte hain aur phir tezi se marte hain. Maut par mahol ka asar bohat kam hota hai; zyada tar afraad apni poori mumkina umr jeete hain. Insanon aur mammals ki populations Type I survivorship dikhati hain.

Type II (diagonal, tirchhi seedhi lakeer) populations: In mein afraad ke marne ka imkaan saari zindagi ek jaisa rehta hai. Maut par mahol ka ahem asar hota hai, aur mahol bachchon par boorhon se zyada sakht nahin hota. Parindon, chhipkaliyon aur rodents (kutarne wale janwar, jaise choohe) ki populations Type II curves dikhati hain.

Type III (concave, andar ko dhansa hua) populations: In mein bachchon ki sharah-e-amwaat (juvenile mortality) bohat zyada hoti hai. Lekin jo jawani tak pohanch jayen un ke marne ki sharah bohat kam hoti hai. Machhliyan aur bohat se invertebrates (baghair reerh ki haddi wale janwar) Type III curves dikhate hain.
